title: Crustacean Poke Bowl
description: A flavorful and refreshing poke bowl loaded with succulent crustaceans and fresh ingredients.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine Aji Amarillo sauce ingredients and blend until smooth.
In a large bowl, combine mixed greens, sliced red onion, diced mango, and crushed macadamia nuts.
In a separate bowl, whisk together lime juice and soy sauce.
Add the sushi-grade shrimp to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Grill the shrimp for 2-3 minutes per side, or until pink and cooked through.
Cut the grilled shrimp into bite-sized pieces.
To assemble the poke bowls, place a scoop of mixed greens mixture in the bottom of a bowl, followed by a portion of the grilled shrimp.
Drizzle the Aji Amarillo sauce over the top and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
